Class SecurityPeriodSeries

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.SecurityPeriodSeries
public final class SecurityPeriodSeries extends Object
Calculates the figures of one security for the period performance per security: absolute gain, time-weighted return in main and security currency, holding days and the remark explaining missing figures.

The values come from the holding periods valued with closing prices and closing rates, the flows from the transaction replay in security currency. The class itself is a pure function of its input; it reads no repository and holds no state, which is what lets every case be fixed with hand-calculated numbers.

  • The grid of the security is the trading days of the period without the days on which it is held but not valued. A trading day without a holding row is a grid day with value 0.
  • A flow of the period, dated by its business date after dateFrom and not after dateTo, is placed on the first grid day on or after that date. Flows of the same placement day and the same security transfer are netted; flows without a transfer are never netted.
  • A flow is converted into the main currency with the closing rate of its placement day, the rate the valuation of that day uses.
  • gain = value(dateTo) - value(dateFrom) - sum of the flows, in both currencies.
  • The return uses ReturnSeries.Convention.REPORT: inflows count from the previous close, outflows at the close.

Amounts are unrounded; rounding is left to the caller.
